<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak at m/z 100.0524 likely corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the proton mass (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 99.0451 Da. The formula C₅H₇O₂ has a calculated monoisotopic mass of 99.0446 Da, matching the observed mass within 0.5 mDa, making it the best candidate.</thought>
<final_answer>C5H7O2</final_answer>
